steps.en: Officer chooses test send of the first message and enters a number or email
steps.id: Officer memilih test send pesan pertama dan mengisi nomor atau email
steps.why_en: The portal has no screen where an officer can enter a test number.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya layar tempat officer mengisi nomor test.

steps.en: The system sends the first message to the entered number or email
steps.id: Sistem mengirim pesan pertama ke nomor atau email yang diisi
steps.why_en: No feature sends a message to a number typed in by the officer.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada fitur yang mengirim pesan ke nomor yang diketik officer.

steps.en: Officer reviews the test SMS or email received
steps.id: Officer meninjau SMS atau email test yang diterima
steps.why_en: Without a test send there is nothing for the officer to review.
steps.why_id: Tanpa test send tidak ada yang bisa ditinjau officer.
